findings.text: The company has the status 'administration' and an insolvency case on record where administration started on 20 March 2024.
Accounts are overdue, with the next due date being 30 September 2024 and the last made up to 31 October 2022.
The confirmation statement is overdue, with the next due date being 7 November 2024 and the last made up to 24 October 2023.
One current person with significant control is CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1445, which holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
There are two current directors: PERSON 314, appointed on 2 July 2021, and PERSON 315, appointed on 25 October 2018.
PERSON 314 has 11 other appointments, including 8 dissolved companies and 2 in liquidation, while PERSON 315 has no other appointments on record.
One registered office address change was filed on 30 December 2025, and there have been no officer appointments or resignations since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 429 is in administration with overdue accounts and confirmation statements, and its directors are linked to other companies in insolvency.
